title: Poor Responders Infertile Patients -A Great Clinical Challenge
brief_summary: infertile , poor responders patients who underwent ICSI. The participants were divided into 2 groups according to the starting dose of Gn stimulation. Group I started with 4 ampoules while group II started with 6 ampoules
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Poor responders according to "Bologna consensus" with at least 2 of the following 3 points should be present:

  1. Age \>40 years or other cause of poor function.
  2. AFC\<2-5 in both ovaries or AMH \< 0.5-1.1 ng/dl 2)
  3. History of poor response with conventional stimulation protocol

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Uterine factor.
2. Severe male factor.
3. Endometriosis.
